cuts.scene: At a masquerade rehearsal, she holds the feathered eye mask beside her cheek on a small amber-lit stage.

cuts.scene: An editorial photo studio with silver-edged black reflectors; she folds an angular fabric panel into a display arrangement.
cuts.outfit: A charcoal halter jumpsuit with open shoulders and cut-outs at the waist, sculpted pleats echoing cactus ribs.

cuts.scene: A coral-sand cove in early morning; her steps leave a trail in the wet sand as a small wave reaches her ankles.
cuts.outfit: An emerald bandeau bikini with a charcoal geometric border, exposing shoulders, waist and legs.

cuts.scene: She smooths a stray lock of hair beside a breakfast tray in a sunlit bedroom.
cuts.outfit: A pale-blue short cotton robe worn loosely open at the shoulders over a matching camisole and shorts, revealing shoulders and collarbones.

cuts.scene: Perched on a dressing-room stool beside a basket of yarn, she rolls a soft yarn ball between her palms.
cuts.outfit: Powder-blue ribbed jersey with white edging, exposing shoulders, midriff and thighs.

cuts.scene: At blue hour, paper lanterns reflect along the river and the first firework trails rise above the distant bridge.
cuts.outfit: A sleeveless white tie-front blouse revealing shoulders and midriff, with a sky-blue pleated mini skirt and a tiny cloud-shaped hair clip.
